name: Hotel Van Zandt
positioning: Music-focused hotel with artistically designed rooms in Austin's Rainey Street Historic District, with a rooftop pool and live performances at Geraldine's
best_for: Live music fans who want to stay in the Rainey Street nightlife district
Couples who want a suite with an oversized soaking tub

facts.text: Hotel Van Zandt is in the Rainey Street Historic District of Austin.
The Rainey Street District is known for its historic charm, bars, live music venues and nightlife.
The hotel's accommodations are artistically designed, and the hotel hosts live performances.
Pool View King rooms look out over the hotel's rooftop pool.
The Pool View King High Floor room has a contemporary design infused with local flair.
Corner King rooms have a spacious layout and a walk-in shower.
The Spa Queen/Queen Junior Suite has two queen beds and a seating area.
The Presidential Suite has a living room, a kitchenette and a dining area.
An accessible One Bedroom Spa Suite has a separate bedroom and living area, an accessible tub and a roll-in shower.
Brass Poppy, the lobby cocktail lounge, combines art-nouveau design with modern sophistication.
Geraldine's serves modern Mexican cuisine with Southern influence alongside live music.
The hotel's event venues host corporate retreats, intimate celebrations and weddings.

highlights.text: The Presidential Suite has a record player, a vintage upright piano and a poker table.
Geraldine's, on the hotel's fourth floor, hosts intimate performances, jazz brunches and DJ sets.
The rooftop pool has lounge chairs and private cabanas.
The One Bedroom Spa Suite's en-suite bathroom has an oversized soaking tub and a walk-in shower.

considerations.text: The hotel provides valet parking; self-parking is not available.
WhataHotel notes the lively neighborhood can bring noise from nearby entertainment venues.
